title: Tiny, cute key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x="38" y="45" width="34" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Shaft highlight -->
  <rect x="40" y="46" width="30" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF176"/>

  <!-- Key bow (round head) -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="18" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <!-- Bow inner ring -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="11" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Bow hole -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="50" r="6" fill="#E6A800"/>
  <!-- Bow highlight -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="45" r="4" fill="#FFE082"/>

  <!-- Teeth -->
  <rect x="64" y="55" width="8" height="12" rx="2" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <rect x="60" y="55" width="6" height="9" rx="2" fill="#FFC107"/>
  <rect x="72" y="55" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFC107"/>

  <!-- Teeth highlights -->
  <rect x="65" y="56" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <rect x="61" y="56" width="3" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFE082"/>
  <rect x="73" y="56" width="3" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFE082"/>

  <!-- Cute face on bow -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="47" r="2" fill="#5D4037"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="47" r="2" fill="#5D4037"/>
  <path d="M29 53 Q32 56 35 53" stroke="#5D4037" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="32" r="2" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#FFF59D"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="70" r="2" fill="#FFE082"/>
</svg>
